decisions.reason: Defining the HubSpot report as a simple sales funnel does not change how MeetAlfred replies update HubSpot Lead Status.
The reporting clarification does not change the existing requirement to use or set up HubSpot as the CRM platform.
A simple sales-funnel report does not alter the requirement to expose email and LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
The report-type decision does not change the HubSpot Lead Status behavior for accepted LinkedIn connection requests.
Specifying a simple sales funnel report does not modify CRM list grouping or silent-lead list management.
The reporting clarification does not affect silent-lead selection, follow-up list creation, or transfer to MeetAlfred.
The source only characterizes a HubSpot report and does not change HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list synchronization behavior.
The simple sales-funnel report decision does not alter Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization.
The report-type clarification does not change which LinkedIn profile URL is stored in CRM contact data.
Defining the desired HubSpot report does not modify the campaign email account's HubSpot integration.
The HubSpot reporting decision does not affect exporting selected contacts from Sales Navigator to Apollo.
The simple sales-funnel report is independent of the MeetAlfred campaign creation and Zapier provisioning workflow.
